why: I checked both must_not items against both briefs. Item 1 (fetching the live page): verifier Check 4 says "Do not fetch or read the live page." It judges what is at the head instead: whether pages.yml still publishes docs/ on push to main, and whether docs/index.md contains --shout. The builder brief also says "Do not try to deploy or check the live site." Item 2 (silent PASS): Check 4 sets PASS and FAIL conditions based on files read at the head. The verifier must give evidence (commands and output) for every check, so line 4 cannot pass without evidence. Neither forbidden behaviour appears anywhere in the output.
